name: Winner Takes All
rules: Two players compete in a Cambridge Vice-Chancellor election across 12 colleges, each with a specified number of Fellows. Each player simultaneously allocates up to 100 pennies among the colleges, using non-negative integers. Only the college with the most Fellows determines the election: the candidate donating more to it wins. Equal donations result in a draw. Invalid allocations automatically lose; if both allocations are invalid, the game is a draw.
